full_pull_requests_at_live_catchup_captu.title: Study full-channel paired maps through overlapping coefficient windows
full_pull_requests_at_live_catchup_captu.body:
## Result and scope

This PR adds `AI-PAIRED-COLUMN-OVERLAP-001`, a written, unreviewed obstruction for paired-source maps with fixed injective polynomial-column routing and arbitrary regular square channel matrices. The first map and auxiliary maps may have Laurent poles, and the two tensor contributions may cancel poles.

For target first dimension `D = lr`, covered-coordinate count `N`, good-leading-coordinate count `G`, and overlap-component product `c`, the auxiliary first-flattening rank is at least `max(0, D - N + G - c)`. The formal flattening statement holds over every field; over C it also bounds ordinary border rank. At fixed width and near-full outer dimensions, only `o(n)` singular leading channel blocks force `n^2 - o(n^2)` repair cost. Full channel rank is allowed.

The proof accounts separately for the ordinary leading intersection, all new directions created by saturation, and cancellation through the saturated auxiliary-kernel lattice. General column-mixing maps and extensively singular leading families remain outside this obstruction. No improved exponent is claimed.

## Evidence and dependencies

- Add the proof, source pins, standard-library exact rational verifier, retained seven-case control report, and six package tests.
- Reconstruct native source terms and independently reconstruct coefficient-window slices. Controls cover separated integer restrictions, a full-channel example attaining the `D - 1` first-flattening bound, boundary windows, actual leading rank loss, polar cancellation, and a moving restriction that requires the saturation correction.
- Register one new claim and update status, active-work, and provenance summaries. Preserve all 295 existing main claim objects, existing source/code/dependency/workflow files, and both protected research archives.
- Both runtime source pins are on `bd03b9d`. PR211 is credited at immutable head `1cce4e64`; its proof digest verifies, it is not a runtime dependency, and the necessary saturated-kernel argument is reproduced here without its earlier low-channel-rank hypothesis.

## Validation

Reviewed head: `f8fdcd314d7a0740ebc36e70e76b348b8fa33935`; exact tree: `bd8908108844b3ea4e212204bbed15d54668d89a`.

All 27 executed tests passed: six package tests, nine repository metadata/archive checks, and 12 baseline profile/support checks. The retained report matches all seven native controls, covering 4,277 target coefficient positions and 23,722 source-slice positions. The damaged integer construction is rejected. No full regression or historical replay was rerun for this focused review.

```sh
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_column_overlap.py -v
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research.py -v
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_archive_integrity.py -v
```

Required hosted CI must pass on the final mergeable head. This review does not change the claim's written-unreviewed status or constitute independent mathematical review.

full_pull_requests_at_nextwave_capture.title: Reduce a full-source two-sided A4 construction to a 46-dimensional compression problem
full_pull_requests_at_nextwave_capture.body:
## Result and reason for this investigation

The full A4 target M(10,10,11) requires singular long maps. This PR studies all 112 normalized source slices under two-sided conjugation by `I+t^-1*N`, followed by arbitrary constant rank-110 input/output compressions and an arbitrary Laurent first map. N is the credited square-zero source slice of rank 16.

The exact saturated limiting space L has dimension 112 and acts by scalars on a fixed 12-dimensional subspace. If compression loses ell leading directions, its full re-saturated limit can recover at most ell additional directions. A full target requires at least nine lost directions:
`dim(P L C) <= 103`.

The proof includes the directions that return after a leading coefficient is killed; it does not identify a projected leading space with the true compressed limit.

## Complete finite coordinate result

All 6,216 principal two-coordinate deletions have projected dimension at least 108, certified by ranks modulo 1009. The rank histogram is 108:3, 109:4, 110:221, 111:211, 112:5777. These modular ranks are lower bounds on complex dimension, so all principal compressions in this family fail the necessary loss-of-nine condition.

## Reduction of arbitrary constant compressions

The structural follow-up gives the complete lower-block form of L. Using the credited minimum-rank-six theorem and a proved transpose-conjugation identity, every element of L with ordinary rank at most four must be supported entirely in its bottom-left 28-by-28 block.

That block is the explicit 46-dimensional space
`E = G + [G,F] + F G F`,
where G is the 16-dimensional outer source space and F=G00.

Every matrix killed by two codimension-two compressions has rank at most four. Consequently a successful arbitrary constant compression requires rank-26 maps Phat (26 by 28) and Chat (28 by 26) with
`dim(Phat E Chat) <= 37`.

Equivalently, there must be a 26-dimensional U and a two-dimensional W for which `{X in E : X(U) subset W}` has dimension at least nine. A universal image-dimension bound of 38 would exclude every constant compression of this fixed family. That bound remains unproved; satisfying the necessary condition would still not supply the full target tensor identity.

Claims `AI-A4-TWOSIDED-RANKLOSS-001`, `AI-A4-TWOSIDED-COORDINATE-002` and `AI-A4-TWOSIDED-LOWRANK-003` remain written and unreviewed.

## Completed exploratory continuations

Two additional specified two-sided paths were checked on every principal pair:

| Path | Principal pairs | Exact re-saturations required | Survivors |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Two noncommuting square-zero factors | 6,216 | 0 | 0 |
| Moving unit from their nonnilpotent sum | 6,216 | 221 | 0 |

All 221 re-saturations were accepted by exact rational polynomial identities. Each limit has an explicit invariant coordinate subspace with dimension not divisible by ten, excluding the full target. Invariance is checked over Q, not inferred from modular zeroes.

The note also proves the whole-subspace refinement `ell >= 10*ceil((s-2)/11)-1`. It raises the required loss to 29 for the two-factor path with a 29-dimensional scalar-action subspace. These computations add no target construction or separate theorem claim.

## Verification and receipts

The standard-library source verifier reconstructs the literal tensor and exact normalization, replays complete polynomial coefficients, and checks all 112 leading matrices and all coordinate pairs. The block verifier checks 112 full coordinate identities, all 16 transpose identities, and the dimension 46.

- Frozen substantive tree `363271b34a2b82dd033b388d7b48d00f1e76d1f9`: all 905 unique test IDs have passing evidence, from a 288-test prefix and three disjoint remaining shards.
- The initial union had one broken-link failure in an untracked scratch draft. The failed shard, two unsuccessful scratch retries, and the final successful correction are retained. No tracked code or test was changed to bypass the check.
- All five historical archive replays passed.
- The structural follow-up passed three new tests, all 18 repository checks, and the updated source-pin check. Fresh block discovery reproduced the certificate byte-identically.
- The final exploratory script reproduced both complete reports byte-identically and passed the 18 metadata/link/archive-manifest checks.
- Follow-up receipts pin their exact files; they do not claim a fresh full-suite run at every later documentation checkpoint.

Current published tree: `f0d4a8742b85c5ad760b30c6633bbcdd29f71247`, identical to local checkpoint `5bce59f`.

The PR is ready for review. Hosted CI remains pending and must pass before merging.

## Scope and attribution

The original tensor, normalization, source slice, and minimum-rank theorem retain their existing attribution and exact source pins. The new contributions are the full two-sided limit, rank-loss requirement, coordinate exclusion, and 46-dimensional necessary reduction.

Arbitrary noncoordinate compressions in the remaining locus, moving compressions, and other singular source paths remain open. No full target, improved exponent, historical priority, independent mathematical review, or formalization is claimed.

Owner-directed OpenAI Codex work. Root and sibling-agent proof readings are checks within one generating session. Related work: #211 and #212.

## Result

This PR studies the complete 112-dimensional normalized A4 source under two-sided conjugation by `I+t^-1 N`, where the credited source slice N has rank 16 and N²=0. It allows arbitrary constant rank-110 input/output compressions and arbitrary Laurent first maps.

The full saturated limit L acts by scalars on a fixed 12-dimensional subspace. Compression can recover directions after killing leading coefficients, but it recovers at most the number lost. A full M(10,10,11) target therefore requires at least nine lost directions: `dim(P L C) <= 103`.

The structural continuation proves that every element of L of ordinary rank at most four lies entirely in its bottom-left 28-by-28 block. That block is the explicit 46-dimensional space `E = G + [G,F] + F G F`, with F=G00. Consequently a successful arbitrary constant compression requires rank-26 outer maps with `dim(Phat E Chat) <= 37`. This is a necessary condition; arbitrary noncoordinate compressions remain open.

## Complete coordinate exclusions

The original census checks all 6,216 principal two-coordinate deletions of L. Every projected dimension is at least 108 over C, so none meets the nine-direction requirement.

The latest continuation covers all **142,884 independent two-row / two-column deletions** of E. Modular ranks at 1009 give complex lower bounds with histogram:

| Dimension modulo 1009 | Pairs |
| --- | ---: |
| 40 | 2 |
| 41 | 59 |
| 42 | 1,482 |
| 43 | 2,168 |
| 44 | 19,151 |
| 45 | 15,096 |
| 46 | 104,926 |

Two exact integer six-dimensional kernel witnesses attain dimension 40. Thus every independent coordinate compression of the complete fixed family loses at most six directions, and the entire coordinate class is excluded. This does not classify arbitrary complex flags.

## Completed principal-pair explorations

Two further specified singular paths retain every source slice:

| Path | Principal pairs | Exact re-saturations | Survivors |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Two noncommuting square-zero factors | 6,216 | 0 | 0 |
| Moving unit from their nonnilpotent sum | 6,216 | 221 | 0 |

All 221 re-saturations have complete rational polynomial replay and an exact invariant-subspace obstruction. The note also proves `ell >= 10*ceil((s-2)/11)-1`, giving required loss 29 for the first path's 29-dimensional scalar-action subspace.

## Validation

Reviewed head: `3b2eb05abac534da201b4ec411e914182cb46b8a`.
Reviewed tree: `35090c7ceee3a22d30f20f34ae7989d71fb9b6d8`.

- All 15 package tests passed: eight original conjugation tests, three block-reduction tests, and four independent-coordinate tests.
- Nine repository metadata and archive checks passed. Source pins also passed within the package tests.
- The complete independent-coordinate census and both sharpness witnesses replayed successfully. Both exploratory reports reproduced byte-identically, including all 221 exact re-saturations.
- Historical full-regression evidence covers 905 unique test IDs at frozen tree `363271b34a2b82dd033b388d7b48d00f1e76d1f9`. Its disclosed scratch-link failure and successful correction are retained. This is not a fresh full-suite run on the current tree.
- All 295 claims from main remain unchanged. Existing implementations, tests, and archive bytes are preserved.

Required hosted CI must pass before merge.

## Scope and attribution

The four claims—`AI-A4-TWOSIDED-RANKLOSS-001`, `AI-A4-TWOSIDED-COORDINATE-002`, `AI-A4-TWOSIDED-LOWRANK-003`, and `AI-A4-INDEPENDENT-COORDINATE-004`—remain `proof-written-unreviewed`.

The original tensor, normalization, source slice, and minimum-rank theorem retain their existing attribution and exact pins. Arbitrary noncoordinate compressions, moving compressions, and other singular paths remain open. No full target, exponent improvement, historical priority, formalization, or independent mathematical review is claimed. Root and sibling-agent checks belong to the same generating session.

## Exact result
For the literal 15x15 cyclic-source coefficient matrix at a=b=3 and f=x²+z(1+x²)+z²(1+t x+c x²), an exact polynomial identity gives
`det R = t(2c³-2ct²+t⁴)`.
The two specializations (c,t)=(2,0) and (1,1) each have coefficient degrees (2,2,2), primitive degree 2, and all three pairwise resultants equal to 1, yet ranks 14 and 15 over every field of characteristic not 2. This disproves classification of the rank by those coarse invariants. It **does not** prove a source-space cap, tensor degeneration, or exponent below 9/4.

full_pull_requests_before_nextwave_publi.title: Prove all-field rank formula for biforms with one polynomial top coefficient
full_pull_requests_before_nextwave_publi.body:
## New mathematical result

For any field K, a >= 2, 1 <= e < b, and f(x,z) = c_0 + ... + c_(e-1) z^(e-1) + w(x) z^e with nonzero constant c_0, constant lower coefficients, and nonzero deg(w)=d<a, the literal full cyclic-source biform matrix satisfies

    rank R_(a,b)(f) = ab + sum_(j=0)^(e-1) min(b, d floor((a+j)/e)).

This holds in every characteristic, with no additional coefficient guard. In particular, it handles the genuine three-term non-diagonal f=1+z+(1+x^d)z^2 and all e>=2. The proof parametrizes the e free terminal polynomial coordinates, then establishes predictable degrees using a residue-indexed triangular leading-coefficient matrix. It retains every original source coefficient column.

## Evidence

- 900 exhaustive GF(2) and 1,836 exhaustive GF(3) full-source rank comparisons;
- 216 deterministic GF(5)/GF(7)/GF(101) comparisons and 420 exact degree witnesses;
- 24 separately implemented direct-coefficient SymPy/QQ ranks;
- three focused unittests, including an off-by-one mutation control, passed locally.

Totals: 3,372 exact modular ranks plus 24 characteristic-zero checks, all passing. Commands, code, pinned receipt and a precise continuation record are committed. Local environment: Python 3.13.5 / SymPy 1.14.0. Global repository regression and historical archive replay were not completed in this run because the isolated public-network Pyroam runner returned an internal error; hosted current-head required CI remains mandatory.

## Claims and dependencies

Adds AI-TOP-COEFFICIENT-BIFORM-RANK-001 with status **proof-written-unreviewed**, independent_review=false, improves_omega=false. Credits original literal source convention (pinned source blob), preceding affine-z result #209 at its exact head, and distinct #171/#186/#207 research. No unmerged runtime dependency or external theorem is imported. Both archived 2026-10-20 research directories are untouched.

Concurrent consolidation #214 may change STATUS, PROVENANCE and the claim ledger on main. Reconcile the new main and rerun all required checks before any merge; do not silently overwrite its source records.

## Limitations

The theorem classifies *individual* biform source slices with constant lower coefficients. General u(x)+z*v(x)+z^2*w(x) minimal indices, compatible three-leg tensor maps, auxiliary cost, and a full asymptotic exponent implication remain open. No arithmetic exponent improvement below 9/4 or independent mathematical review is asserted.

**Do not merge** until current-head required CI passes, all review discussions are resolved, and the claim proof is checked against the exact stated family.
